caption: The drawing is composed of five outlined objects arranged on a beige background with black lines. At the top left is a simple rectangular frame with straight edges. Adjacent to it, at the top right, is another rectangular frame, but this one has a decorative, wavy edge with circular details in each corner. Below these frames are three views of a single furniture piece. The bottom left image shows the front view of a small, rectangular cabinet or side table with two visible drawers, each featuring two handle/pull designs resembling stylized floral motifs, and four turned legs connected by lower stretchers. To its right is a side view of the same cabinet, revealing the same top overhang, a recessed central section with a drawer pull, and one of the turned legs. The final view, at the far bottom right, is another side view of the cabinet. The scale at the bottom right reads “1/4” to 1’.”
title: Box Desk on Frame
